s: Sa vikzepe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudAM-paraMsakaM-sew .) Sa, kirati । asyApi nizWAyAM kIrRa iti । sUlvAdyodidityatra mUrcCavarjanasAmarTyAt yena kenApi prakAreRa rePAntAnnizWAtasya na iti vyAKyAnAt FdiraRAviti iti uri ca kfte rAntatvAt nizWA tasya na syAt । evaM gF Sa nigaraRe ityAderapi gIrRa ityAdi boDyam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
Ya gi hiMse । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (kryAM-uBaMsakaM-sew .) Ya gi, kfRAti kfRIte । kIrRaH kirRiH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ka Na vijYAne । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curAMAtmaM-sakaM-sew .) ka Na, kArayate । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: vikzepe tudA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । kirati akArIt । akArizwAm cakAra cakaratuH cakariva । karItA । ka(ri)rIzyati karI(ri)tavyaH kAryyaH । karmmaRi kIryyate akAri akArizAtAm akAri(ka(ri)rI) sAtrAm kiran kIryyamARaH । kIrRRaHkIrRRiH karI(ri)tuB anu + paScAt kzepe anukirati anukIrRRaH apa + harpavAsaBakzaRArTatayA Kanane tatra catuzpAjantu--pakzi karttfke A॰ suw ca । apaskirate hfzwo vfzaH BakzArTI kukkuwaH । vAsArTI SvA vA । harzABAve tu na sfw na vA taNa । apakirati kusumam । ava + aDaHkzepaRe dUrataHprakzepe ca saka॰ avakirati malArTe suw avaskaraH । vratAt patane aka॰ । avakIRRIM A + samantAt kzepaRe vistAre ca saka॰ “AkIrRRamfzipatnInA muwajadvAraroDiBiH” raGuH ud + utKanane (gAqA) utkIrRRaSabde udA॰ sam + ud + Cedane vidAraRe hiMsAyAM ca saka॰ “maRO vajrasamutkIrRe” raGuH upa + Cedane suw ca । upazkirati parA + samyaka kzepe vyAptO ca saka॰ parAkIrRRaH pra + prakzepe saka॰ nAnAjAtIyErmelane । prakIrRRam prati + hiMsAyAm suw ca । “urovidAraM praticaskare naKEH” mAGaH vi + vikzepe saka॰ “vyavIryyata tryambakapAdamUleH kumA॰ sam + miSraRe । saNkaraH saNkIrRRaH
hiMsane kyrAdi॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । kfRAti akArIt । cakAra cakare karItA karo(ri)zyati te । kIrRaH kIrRiH
vijYAne curA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ sew । kArayate acIkarata ।
m: 1. कॄ cl. 6. P. किरति (Pāṇ. vii, 1, 100; perf. -चकार, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 11, Kāś.; 2nd fut. करिष्यति; 1st fut. करिता or करीता, Vop. xiii, 2; aor. अकारीत् [Ved. सं कारिषत्]; ind.p. -कीर्य; Pass. कीर्यते), to pour out, scatter, throw, cast, disperse, RV. i, 32, 13; MBh. &c.; to throw up in a heap, heap up, Kāṭh. xxviii, 4 : Ā. किरते, to throw off from one's self, RV. iv, 38, 7 : P. to strew, pour over, fill with, cover with, MBh.; R.; (perf. 3. pl. चकरुर्), Bhaṭṭ. : Desid. चिकरिषति, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 75 : Intens. चाकर्ति, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 92, Kāś.; [cf. Gk. κεράννυμι, κίρνημι.]
2. कॄ (or v.l. कृ) cl. 5. 9.P. Ā. कृणोति, ˚णुते, ˚णाति, ˚णीते, to hurt, injure, kill, Dhātup.; Vop. xvi, 2; कृण्वति, Naigh. ii, 19.
3. कॄ (v.l. for गॄ) cl. 10. Ā. कारयते, to know, Dhātup. xxxiii, 33; to inform, ib.
a: कॄ — {vI.v} {c6c} P. (किरति, चकार, अकारीत्, अकरि-री-ष्ट, अकीर्ष्ट, करि-री-तुं, कीर्ण) 1 To scatter, throw about, pour out, cast, disperse; समरशिरसि चंचत्पंचचूडश्चमूनामुपरि शरतुषारं कोप्ययं वीरपोतः किरति U. 5. 2; 6. 1; दिशि दिशि किरति सजलकणजालं Gīt. 4; Ś. 1. 7; Amaru. 11. --2 To strew, cover or fill with; Bk. 3. 5, 17. 42. {vII.v} {c9c} U. (कृणाति, कृणीते) To injure, hurt, kill. {vIII.v} {c10c} A. (कारयते) To know, inform.

s: ka saMSabde । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curAM --paraM--sakaM--sew .) dIrDI । ka, kIrttayanti ca gozWIzu yadguRAnapsarogaRAH । kIrttAdeSasya nityatve'pi kFtapAWaH kIrttAdeSasya vyaBicArasUcanArTaH tena acIkftaditi sidDam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
a: कॄत् — {c10c} U. (कीर्तयति-ते, कीर्तित) 1 To mention, repeat, utter: नाम्नि कीर्तित एव R. 1. 87. Ms. 7. 167, 2. 124. --2 To tell, recite, declare, communicate; Ms. 3. 36, 9. 42. --3 To name, call. --4 To praise, glorify, commemorate; अपप्रथत्गुणान् भ्रातुरचिकीर्तच्च विक्रमं Bk. 15. 72.

v: saMSaye saSabde cu॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । kIrtayati--te acakIrttat--ta kavikalpadrumaH ।
